name: NVIDIA Corporation
thesis: NVIDIA trades at $236.06 with a market cap of $5.70T, down 0.59% intraday and near its 52-week high of $243.37 [1]. The company posted FY2026 revenue of $215.94B (up 65.47% YoY) with a net margin of 55.6%, and trailing-twelve-month figures show even stronger profitability with 74.67% gross margin and 63.66% net margin [1]. Valuation appears reasonable relative to growth, with a trailing P/E of 29.93 compressing to a forward P/E of just 14.88, alongside low leverage (debt-to-equity of 0.17) and robust free cash flow of $41.81B [1]. However, the 10-K flags material risks including long manufacturing lead times and supply-demand mismatches, export restrictions tied to complex regulatory and political dynamics, and intensifying competitive pressure on market share [2].

risks.text: Long manufacturing lead times and uncertain supply and capacity availability, combined with a failure to estimate customer demand accurately, has led and could lead to mismatches between supply and demand.
risks.detail: We have long manufacturing lead times and build finished products and maintain inventory in advance of anticipated demand. In periods of shortages impacting the semiconductor industry and/or limited supply or capacity in our supply chain, the lead times for certain supply may be extended. We have previously experienced and may continue to experience extended lead times of more than 12 months.
